name: Nightpage: PDF Book Reader
tagline: Read PDF books, listen to them, and scan paper books — entirely on your iPhone and iPad.
tracking_detail: The free version shows ads from Google AdMob in the Library — never on the reading or listening screens. If you choose **Allow** in the App Tracking Transparency prompt, Google AdMob may use your device's advertising identifier (IDFA) to personalise ads and measure them across other companies' apps. If you choose **Ask App Not to Track**, the IDFA is not used, ads are not personalised, and every feature keeps working. You can change this at any time in *iOS Settings → Privacy & Security → Tracking*. Nightpage Pro removes ads.
storage_summary: Your books, the pages you scan, the text recognised from them and your reading position are stored only on your device. Text recognition and read-aloud run on your device; your books are never uploaded.

admob.name: Google AdMob (Google Mobile Ads and User Messaging Platform)
admob.purpose: Shows the ads that keep the free version free, measures how they perform, and asks for your ad-privacy choices where the law requires it.
admob.data: your advertising identifier (IDFA) only if you allow tracking, your IP address, device model, OS version, and your interactions with ads (views and taps)

firebase.name: Google Firebase (Google Analytics for Firebase, Crashlytics)
firebase.purpose: Tells us which features are used — for example whether a book was opened, read aloud or scanned — and reports crashes. Usage events never include the titles or contents of your books.
firebase.data: in-app usage events, device model, OS version, app-generated identifiers and crash logs

data_sent.what: Advertising identifier (IDFA) — only if you allow tracking
IP address, device model, OS version and ad interactions
data_sent.why: Show ads, prevent ad fraud and measure ad performance

data_sent.what: Your ad-privacy choices (where the law requires a consent form)
In-app usage events, device model, OS version and app identifiers — never book titles or contents
data_sent.why: Understand which features are used and improve the app

stored_on_device: The PDFs you add to your library. They are copied into the app's own storage on your device.
The pages you scan with the camera, the text recognised from them, and the books made from them. Text recognition (Apple Vision) runs on your device; your pages are never uploaded.
Read-aloud uses the voices built into iOS and runs on your device. The text being read is never sent anywhere.
Your reading position, page theme, brightness, voice and speed settings.
Delete a book in the **Library** (touch and hold its cover → Delete), or delete the app to remove everything.
not_collected: Your name, email address or any account — the app has no sign-in.
The titles or contents of your books, or the pages you scan.
Your photo library — the app does not ask for access to it.
Your precise location, contacts, microphone or browsing history.

permissions.name: Camera
permissions.why: to scan pages of your paper books. Scans and the text recognised from them stay on your device.

permissions.name: Tracking (App Tracking Transparency)
permissions.why: to ask whether ads may use your advertising identifier. Saying no does not limit any feature.

your_controls: **Change your ad-privacy choices** in *Settings → Privacy Choices* (shown in regions where the law requires it, such as the EEA, the UK and some US states).
**Stop tracking** in *iOS Settings → Privacy & Security → Tracking*.
**Delete your books** in the Library, or delete the app to remove everything.

subscription.restore_location: in Settings → Nightpage Pro → Restore Purchases, and at the bottom of the Nightpage Pro screen

support_faq.q: Are my books or scans uploaded anywhere?
support_faq.a: No. Your PDFs, scanned pages, recognised text and reading positions stay on your device. Text recognition and read-aloud run on your device.

support_faq.q: Read-aloud skipped a line or misread a word on a scanned page. What can I do?
support_faq.a: Pages marked **Check page** may have missed a line. Tap the badge and retake that page with the book pressed flat in good light. Retakes do not use your free scan pages.

support_faq.q: How do I get a better reading voice?
support_faq.a: Nightpage uses the voices installed on your device. Download an Enhanced or Premium voice in *iOS Settings → Accessibility → Spoken Content → Voices*, then pick it in *Settings → Voice*.
Unlimited scanning, unlimited listening and no ads. Choose a yearly subscription or a one-time Lifetime purchase. Both work with Family Sharing.

support_faq.q: How do I restore my purchase on a new device?
support_faq.a: Open *Settings → Nightpage Pro → Restore Purchases*, signed in with the same Apple ID you bought with.

support_faq.q: How do I delete my data?
support_faq.a: Delete a book in the Library, or delete the app. Everything lives only on your device, so this removes it completely.
